title: Days on Hand Before a Vacation Release — Refill-Date Convention
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, early refills for travel.** The days on hand taken off a vacation release are counted by the on-hand measure, according to the kind of drug and its latest refill.

**Drug and refill.** The drug is the one named on the latest vacation override granted on the coverage, and its supply is measured from the latest paid refill of that drug.

**Convention.** The on-hand measure counts, for a controlled substance, the days from today to the ordinary controlled refill date, which is the whole number of days, fractions dropped, in the plan's controlled refill percent of the latest refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled; for a drug that is not controlled and whose latest refill was for twenty-eight (28) or more days, the same count at the plan's ordinary refill percent; and otherwise the refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled; each count is never below zero.

A controlled substance is a drug whose latest refill carries a DEA schedule (CII to CV). The refill percents are the member's PrairieRx plan's refill thresholds for controlled substances and for other drugs.

### Method table

| Latest refill of the drug | Days on hand |
|---|---|
| Controlled substance | Whole days of the controlled refill percent of its days supply, less the days since it was filled; never below zero |
| Not controlled, 28 days supply or more | Whole days of the ordinary refill percent of its days supply, less the days since it was filled; never below zero |
| Not controlled, under 28 days supply | Its days supply less the days since it was filled; never below zero |

### Worked figures (hypothetical percents: 90 for controlled, 75 for others)

| Latest refill | Days since filled | Computation | Days on hand |
|---|---|---|---|
| Controlled, 30 days | 10 | 90 percent of 30 is 27; 27 less 10 | 17 |
| Not controlled, 30 days | 10 | 75 percent of 30 is 22.5, fractions dropped 22; 22 less 10 | 12 |
| Not controlled, 21 days | 10 | 21 less 10 | 11 |
| Not controlled, 28 days | 25 | 75 percent of 28 is 21; 21 less 25, never below zero | 0 |
